verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming app, and a product of this kind could plausibly ship an official SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no SDK. Building the app from source with SwiftPM and running the SillHost binary are build steps for the app itself, not an official SDK, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
